profile.position: the 'god'; shadow ruler who controls the wars of Astragius; heir of the Quent civilization; Martial's worshipped god
profile.personality: controlling and manipulative; picks Chirico as successor and tests him; survives on Nulgerant and names Chirico guardian of a new God's Child (library pilot 61 DSC2)

names.source: https://akurasu.net/wiki/Armored_Trooper_VOTOMS : Other 'Wiseman'; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Armored_Trooper_VOTOMS:_Phantom_Arc : Other 'Wiseman'

profile.gender_evidence: Source work: voiced by Rumiko Ukai (Wikipedia mirror); library pilot 62 gives no pronoun
profile.position: Veela guerrilla; Potaria's childhood friend, dying when she tells him Kanjelman's aim (library pilot 62)

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 52 DSCR: 彼と接触した (she contacted him); pilot 59 DSCR: 彼の後を追った (followed him), both about Chirico; Wikipedia cast: Hozumi Goda, protagonist Sergeant Major
characters.nickname: 'the Untouchable' (触れ得ざる者, Martial's designation); trait title 'Abnormal Survivor' (異能生存体)
characters.position: Sergeant Major (曹長) of the Melkian Army, Gilgamesh side; AT pilot and former Red Shoulder Battalion member; wandering fugitive/mercenary; Wiseman's chosen successor who shut him down
characters.personality: extremely taciturn and unfriendly, exceptional AT piloting, judgment and physical ability, versatile in everything to do with fighting; in-game personality 'Strong'; resists being controlled
sources: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_pilot_database.wiki : 'Chirico Cuvie' (Personality Strong, ace bonus Abnormal Survivor)

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 52 DSCR: 「フィアナ」が彼女の名前 (Fyana became her name); MAL Fyana bio 'She'; Wikipedia cast Kazuko Yanaga
characters.nickname: 'Phantom Lady', 'Proto One' (プロトワン), 'Perfect Soldier' / 'the prototype' (素体)
characters.position: the first Perfect Soldier (PS) built by the Gilgamesh/Melkian army; Chirico's companion; kept as the Secret Society's prize before joining him in Kummen
characters.personality: created as an absolutely obedient super-soldier; after meeting Chirico first ('the first light she saw') she disobeys orders, becomes gentle and devoted to him; body depends on jijirium

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 54 DSCR: シャッコに阻まれ、彼に「人間のクズ」と呼ばれて (he, Shako, called Kan Yu human trash); MAL Ru Shako bio; Wikipedia cast Issei Masamune
characters.position: mercenary from the planet Quent, member of Assemble EX-10; Berserga DT pilot (Tengoku default unit); later Chirico's ally in the Quent and Niva fights
characters.personality: calm and composed, sparing with words so that each carries weight; faithful to contracts; loses patience with Kan Yu's cruelty and hurls him down; in-game personality 'Strong'
sources: work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_pilot_database.wiki : 'Ru Shako' (Default Unit Berserga DT, Personality Strong)

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 53 DSCR: 自らの保身を図る彼を... (he, Kan Yu, tried to save his own skin); MAL Kan Yu bio 'his subordinates'; Wikipedia mirror voice Masashi Hirose
characters.position: Captain (大尉), AT platoon commander of Assemble EX-10 under Gon Nuu
characters.personality: petty and cowardly; fawns over his superior and orders subordinates around; glory-hungry, poor judgment, cruel to civilians and his men; nurses a grudge against Chirico; ends by turning his gun on Chirico's group

characters.gender_evidence: Library text gives no pronoun for him. Source work: MAL Gotho bio 'his shrewd business dealings', a 50-year-old weapons dealer; Wikipedia cast Kosei Tomita
characters.position: black-market arms dealer of Uoodo; in Kummen a merchant supplying mercenaries and a fixer (顔役) at Assemble EX-10; with Vanilla and Coconna, Chirico's closest friends; still looking after them 30 years later
characters.personality: good eye for people and quick to turn a profit; puts money first but is soft-hearted and caring, hence likable

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 56 DSC2: ココナと結婚 (married Coconna) with the bar run by 'the two'; akurasu Phantom Arc: 'make things up to his wife, Vanilla'; MAL Vanilla bio 'his extensive connections'
characters.position: black-market dealer of Uoodo; former air-force helicopter pilot; ran the bar Phantom Club in Kummen, later a mercenary liaison flying a helicopter; married Coconna; successful businessman with six children 30 years later
characters.personality: cheerful, always smiling and easygoing, good with customers; grumbles about helping Chirico but always does (MAL: brash, loudmouthed); bickers with Coconna until they fall for each other

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 57 DSCR: 歌姫 (diva); DSC2: バニラと結婚し...子供を産む (married Vanilla and bore six children); MAL Coconna bio 'she'; Wikipedia cast Yoko Kawanami
characters.position: war orphan of Uoodo; star singer at the bar Phantom Club in Kummen; later Vanilla's wife and mother of six
characters.personality: tomboyish (お転婆) and outwardly strong-willed, though grief for her family shows now and then; sharp-tongued, loud; fell for Chirico at first sight

characters.gender_evidence: Library text gives no pronoun for him. Source work: MAL Rochina bio 'his tough, calculating demeanor'; Wikipedia cast: Cap. Jean-Paul Rochina, Banjo Ginga
characters.nickname: former alias 'Kotta Ruske' (コッタ・ルスケ)
characters.position: Captain (大尉) of Melkian Army intelligence, Gilgamesh side; later Colonel (大佐) of the Balarant Army; secretly Wiseman's agent watching and guiding Chirico; finally compiles his records at Allegium
characters.personality: tough and calculating; captivated by power (Pailsen's, then Wiseman's); erupts in anger and despair when Chirico throws away what he himself never obtained

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 60 DSCR: 実の娘テイタニア (his own daughter Teitania); pilot 59 DSCR 父モンテ＝ウェルズ卿; ANN and MAL: daughter of Cardinal Montewells, voiced by Yoko Matsuoka
characters.nickname: 'Shield of Order' (秩序の盾, her 13th-rank title in Martial)
characters.position: 13th-rank 'Shield of Order' of the pan-galactic society Martial; Nextant pilot of the Order Buckler; Cardinal Montewells' daughter; later follows Chirico
characters.personality: fights as an emotionless weapon while her auxiliary brain runs; once it is destroyed she leaves her father, comes to feel something special for Chirico and chases after him; in-game personality 'Super Strong'

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 59 DSCR: 父モンテ＝ウェルズ卿 (her father, Lord Montewells); pilot 60 DSCR: 実の娘テイタニア (his own daughter Teitania); ANN cast Masato Yamanouchi
characters.position: Cardinal of Martial, later Pope (法王) after winning the succession; Teitania's father; rival of Cardinal Guno
characters.personality: ambitious and ruthless, will use any means; framed and killed Cardinal Guno to hide the truth, made his own daughter a Nextant; left hollow when Chirico destroys the power he trusted; killed by a ricochet

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 51 DSCR: 彼の懐に肉薄し (closed in on his heart); pilot 58 DSCR: 彼の後継者候補 (his successor candidate). Really a collective of abnormal-survivor minds, so the pronoun is the text's, not biology
characters.position: the 'god' of Martial and the Secret Society; shadow ruler controlling the wars of Astragius from the Quent ruins; heir of the Quent civilization; later on Nulgerant with a new God's Child
characters.personality: controlling; picks Chirico as successor and tests him through Rochina and others; treats wars as tools

characters.gender_evidence: Library pilot 62 DSCR gives no pronoun for him. Source work: MAL Pol Potaria bio 'he made the strategic decision'; Wikipedia mirror voice Show Hayami
characters.position: mercenary of Assemble EX-10; former Kummen regular-army officer and royal guard; kills Kanjelman in the civil war; later president of Kummen; killed by a mysterious Strikedog at the Phantom Club event

Precedence deviations, all in favour of verified official English over Jigoku library English: Lido (Jigoku 'Rid'), jijirium (Jigoku 'Dijirium'; not checked against the Maiden Japan subtitles, which may say 'Didirium'), Quent (Jigoku 'Kuent'), Uoodo, Sunsa. Jigoku library English kept where it agrees with ANN: Kotta Ruske, Fedok Wokkam.
Kanjelman: akurasu's Votoms page writes 'Heloram Kenjelman'; older Wikipedia, the licensed release text, ANN and MAL all say 'Kanjelman', so I treated akurasu as a typo.
Gon Nuu / Bully Kidera: followed akurasu (which matches the older Wikipedia text); ANN, MAL and Jigoku library write 'Gon Nu' and 'Bully Kiderra'.
Kotta Ruske / Fedok Wokkam: ANN cast spellings; Wikipedia's Pailsen Files page has 'Cotta Ruske' and 'Fedok Wockam'.

Teitania (glossary official, matches ANN, MAL and akurasu Shining Heresy) vs 'Titania De Montewells' in the Tengoku pilot database and 'Titania' in the Complete Chart. I believe the Tengoku wiki is the outlier, so no challenge, but the wiki-wins rule would say Titania. Also 'Kan Yuu' in the Complete Chart is a typo of Kan Yu.

Coconna / Vanilla Vartla (glossary) follow Wikipedia and ANN, while akurasu's Votoms pages write 'Cocona Varta' / 'Vanilla Varta' and 'Kunmen' where the glossary has 'Kummen'. I did not touch these; my notes and profiles use the glossary spellings.
Burglarydog (Black Lightning Brigade): the Tengoku mech list says 'Lighting'; I used 'Lightning' (Alone Again page, and the Japanese 稲妻). Strict wiki-wins would give 'Lighting'.
Gluphae (グルフェー): the wiki calls it a planet, the Tengoku entry says a trade city on the planet Melkia; only the spelling was settled.
Gotho name order: Tengoku CHFN is surname first (ゴウト・ブールーズ) but the English name is given-name first ('Bouleuse Gotho') as in every source.
Wiseman gender: 'male' rests on the library's 彼 and the source cast, but Wiseman is a collective consciousness; translators can keep 'he' or use 'it' consistently.

Genders of Gotho, Rochina, Potaria, Kidera, Theo VIII, Montewells, Ypsilon and Fedok Wokkam come from the source work (MAL, ANN or Wikipedia cast), not from the library Japanese, which has no pronoun for them.
